boolean.name: AND
boolean.description: Both sides must be true. Short-circuits: if left is false, right is skipped.

boolean.name: OR
boolean.description: Either side must be true. Short-circuits: if left is true, right is skipped.

boolean.name: XOR
boolean.description: Exclusive or: true when exactly one side is true. Both sides are always evaluated.

boolean.name: NOT
boolean.description: Negates the following operand. Binds tighter than every binary operator, so !a&b is (!a)&b.

comparison.name: Fuzzy Less Than
comparison.description: Ordered comparisons that treat nearly-equal values as equal (~< and ~> are false when fuzzy-equal; ~<= and ~>= are true).

arithmetic.name: Divide
arithmetic.description: Division. No zero guard (same as SimC): x/0 is +/-inf, 0/0 is NaN (every comparison with NaN is false).

arithmetic.name: Divide (SimC)
arithmetic.description: SimC spelling of division - NOT modulo. a%b = a/b.

arithmetic.name: Min
arithmetic.description: SimC min: a>?b = min(a,b). Binds looser than + - * / but tighter than comparisons.

arithmetic.name: Max
arithmetic.description: SimC max: a<?b = max(a,b). Binds looser than + - * / but tighter than comparisons.

grouping.description: Parentheses for grouping. Precedence, low to high: | < ^ < & < comparisons (incl. ~) < <? >? < + - < * / % %% < unary ! @ < primary.

math.name: Floor
math.description: Round down to the nearest integer. The argument is any sub-expression. Only recognised with parentheses.

math.name: Ceiling
math.description: Round up to the nearest integer. The argument is any sub-expression. Only recognised with parentheses.

math.name: Absolute Value
math.description: Magnitude without sign. The argument is any sub-expression. Only recognised with parentheses.

math.name: Absolute Value (prefix)
math.description: SimC unary abs operator, same as abs(x).

math.name: Exponential
math.description: e raised to the power x. The argument is clamped at 709 so it never overflows to inf. Only recognised with parentheses.

yamlStructure.description: Rotation files are YAML with the following top-level structure.

topLevelKeys.name: spec
topLevelKeys.description: Spec ID for this rotation (e.g. 71 for Arms Warrior). Read as rotation metadata.

topLevelKeys.name: entry
topLevelKeys.description: Name of the action list evaluation starts from. Defaults to 'main'. If the named list does not exist the rotation is empty.

topLevelKeys.name: movement_allowed
topLevelKeys.description: SimC expression. When true, cast-time spells can be cast while moving.

topLevelKeys.name: spell_overrides
topLevelKeys.description: Global per-spell condition gates. Key: spell name or numeric spell ID, value: SimC expression AND-ed with every step that uses that spell. Unknown spell names are skipped with a warning.

topLevelKeys.name: config
topLevelKeys.description: Config variables that generate UI widgets. Every widget accepts label (defaults to the key), section (aliases: group, header, category), description and show_override. Unknown type values are skipped with a warning.

topLevelKeys.name: variables
topLevelKeys.description: Named SimC expressions (plural key only) evaluated each tick in dependency order. Reference with var.NAME or variable.NAME.

topLevelKeys.name: variable
topLevelKeys.description: Initial NUMERIC values for action-line variables (written by variable,name=X lines). Not expressions. Applied once at load and kept across hot reloads. Alias: var.

topLevelKeys.name: morphs
topLevelKeys.description: Per-rotation morph map (base_spell: variant or [variants]). Merged over the global _morphs.yaml; a base spell defined here replaces the global entry.

topLevelKeys.name: tier_sets
topLevelKeys.description: Optional item-ID override for set_bonus (slot name -> item ID). Not needed: set_bonus is automatic via _trinkets.yaml set_bonus:.

topLevelKeys.name: lists
topLevelKeys.description: Named action lists (required). Evaluation starts at the 'entry' list (default 'main'). Lists from _shared.yaml lists: are merged in; a rotation list with the same name overrides the shared one. Each step is an action-line string; legacy map steps (cast:, cast_id:, call:, override:, action:, return:) are still parsed.

configWidgetTypes.name: slider
configWidgetTypes.description: Numeric slider (also the type used when type: is omitted). Defaults: min 0, max 100, default 50, decimals 0. Referenced as config.NAME (returns number).
configWidgetTypes.example:
energy_threshold:
  section: "Resources"
  type: slider
  min: 20
  max: 80
  default: 50

configWidgetTypes.name: checkbox
configWidgetTypes.description: Boolean checkbox (persisted). default: true/false (default false). Referenced as config.NAME (returns 0 or 1).

configWidgetTypes.name: dropdown
configWidgetTypes.description: Single selection dropdown. options: list of {label, value} maps, or plain strings (value = index). default: option INDEX (0-based; out of range falls back to 0). Referenced as config.NAME (returns the selected option's value).
configWidgetTypes.example:
burst_mode:
  type: dropdown
  options:
    - label: "Conservative"
      value: 1
    - label: "Aggressive"
      value: 2
  default: 0

configWidgetTypes.name: multi_select
configWidgetTypes.description: Multiple selection. Pre-selection: default (index or list of indices), default_values (option values) and/or default_labels (option labels) — all three are unioned. Use config.NAME.has(VALUE) to check, config.NAME>=1 for count. Aliases: multi-select, multiselect, multi_dropdown, multi-dropdown, multidropdown.
configWidgetTypes.example:
burst_tools:
  type: multi_select
  options:
    - label: "Trinket 1"
      value: 1
    - label: "Trinket 2"
      value: 2
  default: [0]

configWidgetTypes.name: unit_select
configWidgetTypes.description: Party/raid member selector. filter: all (default), tanks, healers, dps. max: selection cap (0 = unlimited). spell: icon ID shown on the member's Party tab frame. Use with cycle=config.NAME; config.NAME returns the selected count. Aliases: unit-select, unitselect.
configWidgetTypes.example:
pi_target:
  type: unit_select
  filter: dps
  max: 1

configWidgetTypes.name: toggle
configWidgetTypes.description: Ephemeral boolean toggle. State always starts OFF (default: is ignored) and is never saved. Shows spell icon on overlay when active. Can be hotkeyed. Referenced as config.NAME (returns 0 or 1). show_override is always true. Rotation config: only — not accepted in _shared.yaml config_shared:.
configWidgetTypes.example:
reju_spread:
  type: toggle
  label: "Rejuvenation Spread"
  spell: 774
  description: "Spread Rejuvenation to group members missing the HoT"

configWidgetTypes.name: number
configWidgetTypes.description: Direct numeric entry (same data as slider, different widget). Referenced as config.NAME (returns number). Defaults: min 0, max 0, default 0; if min and max are both 0, no clamping is applied. Aliases: number_input, number-input, numberinput.
configWidgetTypes.example:
trinket_ilvl_min:
  section: "Items"
  type: number
  min: 0
  max: 999
  default: 600

configWidgetTypes.name: rule_builder
configWidgetTypes.description: User-editable AND/OR/NOT tree over a catalog of named conditions. conditions: list of {id, label, expr} (entries missing id or expr are dropped). default: tree of leaves {ref: ID, not: bool} and branches {op: and|or, not: bool, children: [...]}; when omitted, the first condition is the default. config.NAME evaluates the compiled tree (returns 0 or 1). Unknown refs compile to false. Aliases: rule-builder, rulebuilder.
configWidgetTypes.example:
burst_gate:
  type: rule_builder
  conditions:
    - id: boss
      label: "Boss target"
      expr: target.boss
    - id: lust
      label: "Bloodlust up"
      expr: buff.bloodlust.up.any
  default:
    op: or
    children:
      - ref: boss
      - ref: lust

configWidgetTypes.name: copy_text
configWidgetTypes.description: Read-only text with a Copy button. Display-only — never saved, not referencable in conditions. Useful for talent strings, WeakAura imports, macros. input: or value: are accepted when text: is empty. Aliases: copy, copytext, copy-text.
configWidgetTypes.example:
recommended_talents:
  section: "Talents"
  type: copy_text
  label: "Recommended Talent String"
  text: "B4PAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAESLDgZmlZGTbDsZmlZmZmZmlxMmZmlZ2YmFAA"

configWidgetTypes.name: link
configWidgetTypes.description: Button that opens a URL in the default browser. The label is the button text; the URL appears as a tooltip on hover. href: is accepted when url: is empty. Display-only — never saved, not referencable in conditions. Alias: url.
configWidgetTypes.example:
guide_link:
  section: "Help"
  type: link
  label: "Open Guide"
  url: "https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps"

configWidgetTypes.name: note
configWidgetTypes.description: Static informational text block (wraps to width). Display-only — never saved, not referencable in conditions. Use for explanations longer than what fits in a description tooltip. body: is accepted when text: is empty. Aliases: info, text.
configWidgetTypes.example:
pvp_note:
  section: "PvP"
  type: note
  label: "PvP rotation tips"
  text: "This APL assumes Gladiator's Medallion. Without one, enable manual_dispel and bind it."

configWidgetTypes.name: divider
configWidgetTypes.description: Horizontal separator line. Display-only — never saved, not referencable in conditions. Alias: separator.

configWidgetTypes.name: button
configWidgetTypes.description: Clickable button. If url is set, opens the URL. Otherwise, if text is set, copies it to the clipboard. Display-only — never saved, not referencable in conditions. The action field is reserved for future named-action dispatch.
configWidgetTypes.example:
copy_macro:
  section: "Macros"
  type: button
  label: "Copy interrupt macro"
  text: "/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][@target] Pummel"

actionLineSyntax.description: Each action is: spell_name[.cast_target],modifier=value,...,if=condition. The line is split on commas outside parentheses, so a top-level comma cannot appear inside if= (wrap it in parentheses). Options may come in any order; an option without '=' is a flag set to true (e.g. interrupt). The first token is a special action, a virtual action type, a numeric spell ID, or a snake_case spell name. Boolean options accept true or 1; most underscore options also accept the no-underscore spelling (range_check/rangecheck, ignore_usable/ignoreusable, ...).

castTargets.name: .player
castTargets.description: Cast on self (@player macro). Default range_check becomes none.

castTargets.name: .cursor
castTargets.description: Cast at cursor position (ground targeting). Default range_check becomes none.

castTargets.name: .focus
castTargets.description: Cast on focus target. Default range_check becomes focus.

castTargets.name: .mouseover
castTargets.description: Cast on mouseover target. Default range_check becomes mouseover.

castTargets.name: .focus_mouseover
castTargets.description: Set focus to the mouseover, then press the .focus keybind. Requires the mouseover to come from a friendly unit frame. Default range_check becomes mouseover.

castTargets.name: .SUFFIX
castTargets.description: Any other suffix is stripped from the spell name and used only to look up a keybind bound with that suffix; no special targeting or range behaviour. Default range_check stays target.

specialActions.name: call_action_list,name=LIST
specialActions.description: Inline the named list here, then continue with the next line. The call's if= is AND-ed into every line of the called list (nested calls stack); off_gcd=1 on the call marks every called step off-GCD (except cycle= steps). Recursive calls are ignored.

specialActions.name: run_action_list,name=LIST
specialActions.description: Same as call_action_list, then an implicit return (with the call's condition) is placed after the list: if nothing in it was suggested, the rotation stops for this tick instead of falling through.

specialActions.name: return
specialActions.description: When its if= is true (or with no if=), halt the whole rotation for this tick with no suggestion. Lists are flattened, so this is not a per-list return.

specialActions.name: variable,name=X,op=OP,value=EXPR
specialActions.description: Set or modify action-line variable X (read as var.X / variable.X). Ops: set (default; also any unknown op), add, sub, mul, div, mod, pow, min, max, reset (to default=), floor, ceil, setif (condition= picks value= or value_else=). default= is also used as value when value= is missing. Runs on the on-GCD pass only and never produces a suggestion. Alias: var.

specialActions.name: wait
specialActions.description: When its if= is true, halt the rotation for this tick (no suggestion). Without if= it does nothing. sec= is accepted but ignored; line_cd= rate-limits activation.

stepModifiers.name: if
stepModifiers.description: SimC expression condition. Step only runs when this is true.

stepModifiers.name: range_check
stepModifiers.description: Which unit to range-check. Use 'none' for self-buffs or ground targeting. mob_count_8y/40y pass when at least one enemy is in that range. Any unrecognised value is treated as a spell name whose range is used. When omitted: cycle_member for cycle=/target= steps, otherwise inferred from the cast suffix (.focus -> focus, .mouseover/.focus_mouseover -> mouseover, .player/.cursor -> none, else target). Alias: rangecheck.

stepModifiers.name: casting_check
stepModifiers.description: Require player to be casting. 'any' = any cast, or specify a spell name or numeric ID (an unresolved name never passes). Skips isCurrentSpell guard. Alias: castingcheck.

stepModifiers.name: ignore_usable
stepModifiers.description: Skip the game's usability check (resources, form, silence). Cooldown is still enforced — see ignore_cooldown. Alias: ignoreusable.

stepModifiers.name: ignore_cooldown
stepModifiers.description: Skip only the cooldown check.

stepModifiers.name: ignore_movement
stepModifiers.description: Allow this cast-time spell while moving.

stepModifiers.name: ignore_queue
stepModifiers.description: Skip isCurrentSpell guard, allowing re-pressing to queue same spell. Use with interrupt for filler spam.

stepModifiers.name: ignore_blocked
stepModifiers.description: Bypass the full block gate: Enabled=off/block, CDs toggle off, and TTD gate are all ignored. Use sparingly — overrides the user's explicit disable/block.

stepModifiers.name: ignore_cds_toggle
stepModifiers.description: Bypass the block only when the reason is the global CDs toggle being off. User-disabled and TTD-gated spells still block. Pair with cooldown.X.is_cooldown so the line explicitly opts into firing a CD.

stepModifiers.name: interrupt
stepModifiers.description: Allowed to cut off the player's OWN current cast/channel to use this spell (it does not mean 'kick the target'). Bare 'interrupt' works as a flag.

stepModifiers.name: after
stepModifiers.description: Wait N milliseconds after condition becomes true before executing. Timer resets if condition goes false.

stepModifiers.name: delay
stepModifiers.description: Minimum milliseconds between presses of this spell.

stepModifiers.name: global_delay
stepModifiers.description: Block ALL other spells for N ms after pressing (for channels that need time to register). Alias: globaldelay.

stepModifiers.name: cycle
stepModifiers.description: Iterate group members in cycle_order (default raw HP ascending); the step fires on the first member whose if= passes. party = player + party1-4, cast through direct .partyN binds instead of focus. config.NAME = members picked in that unit_select widget. Every group is LIVING members only, except cycle=dead, which iterates dead members nearest-first and is the only way a line can target a corpse (res / battle-res). cycle= steps are always on-GCD (off_gcd is ignored).

stepModifiers.name: cycle_order
stepModifiers.description: Override cycle iteration order. Default (health) sorts by raw HP ascending so squishy low-max-HP members come first (flat-damage triage); a 200k clothie outranks a 600k tank at the same HP%. Use health.pct for HP%-ascending order, player_first to check the player first, buff/debuff.SPELL.remains[.any] to sort by aura duration ascending, role for healer > dps > tank tiers, or role_X_Y_Z (tokens heal/healer, dps, tank) for an explicit tier order; unlisted roles go last, HP ascending within a tier. Alias: cycleorder.

stepModifiers.name: target
stepModifiers.description: Cast on one resolved group member: the lowest-HP member (optionally by role), the Nth tank (tank1-3, cast through direct .partyN binds), or the lowest member missing buff SPELL. Unresolvable values never fire. Default range_check becomes cycle_member.

stepModifiers.name: override
stepModifiers.description: Use another spell's keybind for pressing.

stepModifiers.name: empower_to
stepModifiers.description: Auto-handle empowered spell: press to start empowering, press again at stage N to fire. Replaces manual casting_check+ignore_usable+ignore_cooldown+empower_stage workaround. Alias: empowerto.

stepModifiers.name: name
stepModifiers.description: Display name for the step (trace/debug). On use_item it is the item to use (resolved via ItemDB). On call_action_list/run_action_list it is the list to call.

stepModifiers.name: chain
stepModifiers.description: SimC channel chaining hint. Parsed, ignored.

stepModifiers.name: use_off_gcd
stepModifiers.description: SimC off-GCD hint. Parsed, ignored — use off_gcd=1 for real off-GCD handling.

stepModifiers.name: use_while_casting
stepModifiers.description: SimC use-while-casting hint. Parsed, ignored.

stepModifiers.name: sec
stepModifiers.description: SimC wait duration (wait,sec=X). Accepted but ignored: wait halts for as long as its if= is true.

stepModifiers.name: hotkey
stepModifiers.description: Override keybind scan code.

stepModifiers.name: modifier
stepModifiers.description: Override key modifier (16=shift, 17=ctrl, 18=alt).

stepModifiers.name: resource
stepModifiers.description: Used with pool_resource: explicitly name the resource to reserve. All steps below this line that cost this resource will be skipped while the pool_resource condition is true.

stepModifiers.name: for_next
stepModifiers.description: Used with pool_resource: auto-detect the resource to reserve from the next N spell steps in the list. The target steps are exempt from being blocked themselves.

stepModifiers.name: off_gcd
stepModifiers.description: Mark step as off-GCD. Evaluated during GCD window and displayed as split icon overlay. Applied automatically to spells listed in off_gcd_spells unless set explicitly. Ignored (forced on-GCD) on cycle= steps. On call_action_list/run_action_list it propagates to every step of the called list.

stepModifiers.name: line_cd
stepModifiers.description: Per-line cooldown in seconds. Prevents re-evaluation of this step for the specified duration after it activates. Also works on wait lines.

stepModifiers.name: snapshot
stepModifiers.description: Auto-capture a diagnostic snapshot when this step is suggested. File named SpellName_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.log with full cache + rotation trace. Fires once per suggestion, resets when a different spell is suggested.

actionTypes.name: trinket_1
actionTypes.description: Use trinket in slot 1. Suppressed for a slot whose item is used by a use_item,name= line.

actionTypes.name: trinket_2
actionTypes.description: Use trinket in slot 2. Suppressed for a slot whose item is used by a use_item,name= line.

actionTypes.name: use_item
actionTypes.description: Use a named trinket: use_item,name=ITEM resolves the item via ItemDB and fires whichever trinket slot holds it. Never fires when the name is unknown or the item is not equipped in a trinket slot.

actionTypes.name: petattack
actionTypes.description: Send pet to attack the current target.

actionTypes.name: queue_spell
actionTypes.description: Fires the first usable spell from the in-game spell queue (addon-side queue). Matches nothing when the queue is empty.

actionTypes.name: one_button_assist
actionTypes.description: Press the one-button assistant keybind directly.

actionTypes.name: one_button_assist_lookup
actionTypes.description: Look up and press the keybind for the spell suggested by the one-button assistant.

actionTypes.name: pool_resource
actionTypes.description: Resource reservation gate. When its condition is true, marks a resource as reserved so lower-priority steps that would spend it are skipped. Use resource= to name the resource explicitly, or for_next=N to auto-detect it from the next N spell steps. The directly targeted spell (for_next) is exempt from the block. Never produces a suggestion — only controls what fires below it.
